eps.d: One sleepless night, as Lucas Amato, a biology teacher at Meridiana High School, was walking down the streets, he witnesses a big man vanish into the air.
Von Reichter, a mad scientist who created Cybersix, sends his "bioroid" pet to Meridiana city in order to terminate Cybersix. The bioroid pet is a black panther called "Data 7".
Von Reichter creates Terra from mud. Terra is given the special power to absorb people's abilities by simply touching them.
Jose visits a competent private detective, Yashimoto, to ask him to conduct an investigation on Cybersix.
Lori, a female student at Meridiana High School is in love with Adrian. However, she sees Cybersix and assumes that she is having a relationship with Adrian.
Meridiana city is filled with the countless blue birds, which begin to attack people in the city.
A police officer, Enrique, is a good friend of Julian. Julian too takes a special liking to him, and tells him about the encounter with Cybersix.
One night, the Winged Goblins streak in to Meridiana City. They irrupt into a subway and cause panic within the passengers.
An artificial Eye appears to Meridiana and it hypnotizes the people one after another. Those who saw this eye stand lifelessly on the streets with blank expressions on their faces.
One night, Cybersix saves Lucas, who has been attacked by a werewolf. The werewolf slashed across Lucas' shoulder during this fight.
Jose captures Data 7 and tries to decoy Cybersix to his circus show of giant mechanical creatures using Data 7 as a bait. Knowing it is a trap, Cybersix goes to rescue her friend.
Grizelda, a woman with the ability to become invisible, comes to Cybersix and attacks her persistently.
A giant creature appears on the offshore and it heads towards the city of Meridiana. Jose finds out what the Monster is and attempts a revolt against his father.
